# Huagongshe (huagongshe.com)

> Huagongshe: look up compounds and reaction data, scale recipes, and keep your own reaction records. Usable directly by humans and AI.

## AI integration (read this first)

- **MCP server (recommended)**: `https://huagongshe.com/mcp` — Streamable HTTP transport; mixed anonymous / OAuth access depending on each tool's declaration
- **MCP OAuth**: standard Authorization Code flow with PKCE S256; scopes are `read`, `reaction:write`, `skill:write`
- **MCP connection guide**: https://huagongshe.com/mcp-guide
- **REST / AI Key compatibility surface**: `https://huagongshe.com/api/agent-guide` — for clients that cannot use MCP and for existing hgs_* AI Key automation; the primary agent integration layer is the MCP server above
- **AI Key (manual compatibility)**: create one after logging in at https://huagongshe.com/me/settings/api-tokens; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <AI Key>`. The HTTP API keeps using AI Keys; an OAuth access token is never accepted as a REST bearer credential and only enters the MCP adapter.

**Anonymous**: unified search (exact mode), compound detail, public reaction detail, molecule/reaction SVG, public skills, stoichiometry calculation
**After MCP OAuth authorization**: structure search (substructure/similarity), reading your own private reactions/skills, listing your reactions, validating/creating reactions, validating/saving skills
**Not provided in v1.7.0**: Note MCP tools and the `note:write` scope

## What you can call

### MCP tools (13 total)

Unified search, compound detail (core/full), reaction detail, molecule/reaction SVG rendering, skill registry browsing, stoichiometry calculation, my reactions, reaction validate/save, skill validate/save. Permission requirements as above.

### HTTP API

| Capability | Endpoint | Notes |
|------|------|------|
| Unified search | `GET /api/search` | Names, CAS, InChIKey, SMILES, structure search (exact is anonymous; substructure/similarity require an AI Key) |
| Compound detail | `GET /api/chemicals/{id}?enrich=core\|full` | core = structure/identifiers/related reactions; full = unified semantic detail (descriptions/names/properties/safety/industrial uses/suppliers/provenance) |
| Reaction detail | `GET /api/reactions/{id}` | Participants, conditions, yields, source, procedure |
| Molecule rendering | `GET /api/mol/{hcid}/svg?w=&h=` | HCID → SVG structure image |
| Stoichiometry | `POST /api/stoichiometry/scale` | Role-tagged components + a basis charge → full charge table / theoretical yield / solvent volume (RDKit) |
| Dataset list | `GET /api/datasets` | Reaction source datasets |

### Operations that require an AI Key

| Capability | Endpoint | Notes |
|------|------|------|
| My reactions | `GET /api/users/me/reactions` | Read the AI Key owner's reaction library |
| Validate draft | `POST /api/reactions/validate` | RDKit canonicalization check, nothing saved |
| Create reaction | `POST /api/reactions` | Saves into the user's reaction library (requires an Idempotency-Key) |

## Safety rules

- Send AI Keys only to `huagongshe.com`; never write them into public prompts, code, or logs.
- When creating/validating a reaction, show the draft to the user for confirmation before saving. Default to `private`; going public requires the user's explicit confirmation.

## Rate limits

Counted per identity; over the limit the API returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header.

| Type | Limit |
|------|------|
| Structure search (substructure/similarity) | 6 per minute per identity; 30 per minute global; 2 (identity) / 4 (global) concurrent |
| Reaction validation | 20 per minute |
| Reaction writes | 10 per minute, 200 per day |
| Stoichiometry calculation | 30 per minute |
| Skill saves | 20 per hour |

## Identifiers

- **HCID** (Huagongshe Chemical ID): internal compound ID, e.g. `12345678`
- **HRID** (Huagongshe Reaction ID): internal reaction ID, e.g. `8765432`
- Search supports prefixes: `id:12345`, `cid:2244`, `cas:64-17-5`, `inchikey:LFQSCWFLJHTTHZ-UHFFFAOYSA-N`
